name: Camera head
description: A white security camera housing with a black glass face, a lidar puck on top and a black swivel bracket that bolts to a pole or wall.

made_with.settings: multi-image (main and side views), textured, PBR

notes: 0.60 m long, lens facing -X, mounting plate at +X. Meshy's 644,646 triangles collapsed to 30,000 in Blender; 8,000 shredded the surface. Smart topology can't take more than one image, so this one is Meshy 7 (Bryson chose, 2026-10-11). Its small red light is too faint in the texture for --glow, so nothing glows yet. Claude still builds the pole.
